proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha hb hc h
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, a n / b n < c + 1 := h.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by linarith))
  have h2 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, c / 2 < a n / b n := h.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by linarith))
  constructor
  · intro hs
    refine (hs.mul_left (2 / c)).of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat ?_
    filter_upwards [h2] with n hn
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hb n).le]
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (hb n)] at hn
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hc]
    linarith
  · intro hs
    refine (hs.mul_left (c + 1)).of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat ?_
    filter_upwards [h1] with n hn
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (ha n).le]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (hb n)] at hn
    exact hn.le
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ n, 0 < a n) → (∀ n, 0 < b n) → 0 < c → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a n / b n) Filter.atTop (nhds c) → (Summable a ↔ Summable b)
